description: Semarang (Indonesia) - Flood Risk Map (ESA EO4SD-Urban) is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Climate, Environment", published or maintained by World Bank Group (World Bank Group). For the Semarang area generally two types of floods are typical and have to be taken into account accordingly: a. Tidal floods in coastal areas due to land subsidence Rates ranging from 1 to 17 cm/year. Coverage: Indonesia. It has 4 files in SHP ZIP, HTML, PDF. The portal files it under Climate, Environment. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
